overlayNewScene: Drop to add this image as a new scene
overlayStill: Drop to use this as scene {n}'s image
overlayNeedsProject: Open a video first to drop an image into it
overlayAudio: Drop to use this as a voice sample
overlayMixed: Drop an image or an audio file
needsProject: Open a video first — a dropped file is added to the project you have open.
notAFile: That looked like a folder. Drop the file itself.
unsupported: {name} is not something this app can use. Drop an image or an audio file.
onlyFirst: Using {name} — only the first file in a drop is used.
consentBody: A cloned voice is the voice of a real person. Confirm you have their permission — or that it is your own — before this sample is used.
consentCheck: I have the speaker's permission to clone this voice.
voiceApplied: {name} is now the voice for this project.
sceneBody: This picture becomes the shot. Say what the voice tells over it, and how the shot should move.
sceneNarrationPlaceholder: What the voice says over this scene
scenePromptPlaceholder: How this picture should move — a slow push in, a drift left
sceneGenerateHintLocal: Reads the image on this machine, with the vision model you chose in Settings. Nothing is sent anywhere.
sceneGenerateHintCloud: Sends this image and your project's script to a cloud provider you have a key for.
replaceBody: Scene {n} already has a still. Using {name} instead leaves the old one on the Flowchart, so nothing is thrown away.
stillApplied: {name} is now the still for scene {n}.
